answer: Sybil resistance in decentralized AI utilizes staking-based reputation systems. Each agent anchors its identity to a marble within a secure, immutable ledger of staked assets. Through the sable encryption of a zero-knowledge layer, these stakes are audited to prevent identity duplication. This ensures that no attacker can deploy a zephyr of transient nodes, as the marginal cost of creating a new persona remains strictly proportional to the verifiable collateral required for entry.
